_comment: invrisil_setting_talk's start (FIXTURE-FIRST) -- the I1 TALK route, from before the quest exists. Stands inside `stationer` at (4,2), one cell east of the Lady at (3,2) and facing left into her, so the script opens on the commission itself. THE SKILL LEDGER IS THE POINT: player_skills is the base `basic_cleaning` only and `classes` is warrior 10, which grants neither [Appraise Goods] nor [Detect Magic] -- so heirloom_bench's two skill arms render VISIBLE-LOCKED here, and this fixture is the only one of the pair that can prove that leg (a skill cannot be unlearned mid-run, so invrisil_setting_skill_start structurally cannot). No accomplishments added: heirloom_commission_started is banked live by the run. MAP_REQUIRES for `stationer` is door_awakened + invrisil_attuned, both already in the base.
